main_text.p: producatur materia. An autem arthriticis propinandum uinum sit non pauci medici dubitant. Qui exhibendum esse censent, rubrum crassum albo tenui anteferunt. Nos autem, quod album est & tenue, oligophorum, & maturum esse potui dandum iudicamus, eo quòd diureticum sit, humoresq; ferosos, qui per uenas in debiliores articulos profluere consueuerunt, euacuet, ac auertat. Caetera autem uinorum genera magnum arthriticis facessunt negotiū, quòd & sanguinem magis magisq; augeant, & fluxiliorem reddant. Posthaec ad ea, quae al teram arthritidis causam, nempe articulorum imbecillitatem expungunt, nobis progredi licet. Illius autem, quae acquisita est, necingenita, hic nobis fermo est: cuius ut plures sunt causae, ita & plura praesidia. Idcirco quae ab immoderata & intempestiva uenere est, continentia discutitur. Propterea nonnulli omnimodā ipsius ueneris abstinentiam commendant. Ob id obscoenarum, uiriliumque partium abscisionem, & omnibus arthriticis, & praesertim uegetis & iuuenibus imperant. Verum quoniam humanae speciei, quae ueneris usu conserva-tur, nimia foret iniuria, idcirco ab eo tam sequero

page.notes: Catchword "sequero" is printed at the foot right, after the last line; the text ends with the last full line "tam", so the catchword is kept only in its element. Last line is partly obscured by a stain at "iniuria" and "conserva-tur" on the left edge. Some words may have printing irregularities (e.g. "sequero" as catchword written "fequero" in the scan) and are copied as printed. Long s throughout is rendered as s. The line "Nos autem" etc. follows the printed text. The foot paragraph is empty and should be removed on review.
